usage_discipline: MIR-1K is test-only: report only, never for checkpoint selection or tuning

canonical_reconciliation.note: mean_iou is the only quantity defined identically in both implementations; MAE differences trace to the canonical song-macro / invalid-penalty conventions

ensemble_membership_rule.rule: a peer enters the ensemble only if its own hit@100 is >= half the reference's

consensus_simulation.honesty: members are five independent inference configurations of the same audio+text, not different audio crops; treat as a proxy upper bound for view-consensus selection

S2_trimmed_mean.note: mean of inner members (drops one extreme per side)

S6_agreement_weighted.note: mean of the largest agreement cluster (radius 40ms)

S4_gate_p50_median.note: spread>80ms (43% of units) replaced by median

S5_gate_p50_loo_median.note: reference kept elsewhere; unstable units use leave-one-out median (threshold 80ms)

S4_gate_p80_median.note: spread>80ms (20% of units) replaced by median

S5_gate_p80_loo_median.note: reference kept elsewhere; unstable units use leave-one-out median (threshold 80ms)

S4_gate_p90_median.note: spread>320ms (8% of units) replaced by median

S5_gate_p90_loo_median.note: reference kept elsewhere; unstable units use leave-one-out median (threshold 320ms)

S7_oracle_member_pick.note: upper bound: per unit pick the member with the smallest true error (uses GT)

summary.interpretation: compare only the *marginal* gain against the re-alignment budget; a strategy that reaches the oracle only by recomputing everything is not a win over simply trusting the single pass

membership.rule: a peer enters the ensemble only if its own hit@100 is >= half the reference's

per_item_variance.note: item-level dispersion is what a per-song quality gate has to live with
